entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Another hold. I just want to return this piece of junk. This is the last time I ever order from you people!
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?

Yeah, 'Alex', I need to return this helmet. Right now. I've had it with this company. If I don't get a return label in my inbox in the next five minutes, I'm lighting you up on every review site on the planet.
I can certainly help you with a return. Just so I can properly document this for you, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's an issue with my eyes! The color is hideous! It looks nothing like the picture online. I'm not wearing this thing. Frankly, the awful color is a safety issue because no one will take me seriously on the road. The box is still unopened, I took one look at it and knew it was going back.
I understand your frustration when an item's color doesn't meet your expectations. I see here that you received the helmet 8 days ago. Let me just confirm the policy for you. One moment.
Don't give me the runaround with 'policy'. Just process the return. It's a simple request. If you can't do it, get me a manager who can.

No need for a manager, I can handle this for you. I've just confirmed, and since the helmet is a standard item and you're well within the 90-day return window, I can approve this return immediately. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to the email on your account right now.
Oh. Okay. So it's approved? The label is on its way?

Yes, that's correct. You should see it in your inbox within the next couple of minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Once we receive it, we'll process your full refund.
Fine. Good. That's all I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
